1.1: Yeinom ne nsɛm a AWURADE yi kyerɛɛ Odiyifoɔ Habakuk:
1.2: O AWURADE, menteam nkɔsi da bɛn ara na wobɛtie me? Nhyɛsoɔ nti mesu mefrɛ wo, nanso wonnye me.
1.3: Adɛn nti na woma mehunu abusudeɛ ne ɔhaw sɛɛ, na wonyɛ ho hwee yi? Ɔsɛeɛ ne nhyɛsoɔ da m’anim, na ɔhaw ba, na akasaakasa asɔre.
1.4: Enti mmara mu ago, na atɛntenenee mfiri ara da, ɛfiri sɛ abɔnefoɔ twa ɔteneneeni ho hyia, enti atemmuo firi a, na akyea. AWURADE maa Habakuk mmuaeɛ
1.5: Monhwɛ amanaman mu na monhunu na mo ho nnwiri mo dwiri pa ara, na mereyɛ adwuma bi, mo nna mu, wɔka kyerɛ mo a, morennye nni.
1.6: Na hwɛ, merehwanyan Kaldeafoɔ, ɔman a wɔn tirim yɛ den na wɔn ho yɛ hare  a wɔnante fa asase so nyinaa fa tenabea a ɛnyɛ wɔn dea di soɔ.
1.7: Wɔn ho yɛ ahomete ne hu, wɔyɛ ahantanfoɔ a wɔyɛ deɛ wɔn ara wɔpɛ.
1.8: Wɔn apɔnkɔ ho yɛ hare sene asebɔ, na wɔyɛ aniɛden sene anwummerɛ mpataku, na wɔn apɔnkɔsotefoɔ twetwe wɔn mu kɔ kan,  na wɔn apɔnkɔsotefoɔ firi akyirikyiri reba, wɔtu sɛ ɔkɔdeɛ a ɔrepɛ adidie ho ntɛm.
1.9: Wɔn nyinaa reba aturuturasɛmdie, na wɔde wɔn ani kyerɛ apueeɛ fam anibereɛ so, na wɔtase nnommum sɛ anwea.
1.10: Wɔn deɛ, wɔsi ahemfo atwetweɛ na aberempɔn ho yɛ wɔn sere, wɔsere aban a ɛyɛ den nyinaa, na wɔboa dɔteɛ ano gu hɔ na wɔafa.
1.11: Ɛno na wɔtwam sɛ mframa, na wɔsene korɔ, na wɔkɔdi so; wɔn ahoɔden yi ara ne wɔn nyame. Habakuk asɛmmisa a ɛtɔ so mmienu
1.12: AWURADE, me Nyankopɔn ne me Kronkronni, ɛnyɛ wo na wofiri tete nteredee? AWURADE, wo ne ɔbotantim; yɛrenwu na mmom wo ara na woahyɛ Kaldeafoɔ sɛ wɔmmu yɛn atɛn na yɛn asotwe nti na wode wɔn asi hɔ.
1.13: Wo a w’aniwa yɛ kronkron a wontumi nhwɛ bɔne na wontumi nhwɛ ɔhaw, adɛn nti na wohwɛ nkɔnkɔnsafoɔ,  na ɔbɔnefoɔ mene ɔteneneeni a ɔtene sene no a,  woyɛ komm?
1.14: Afei nso, woayɛ nnipa sɛ ɛpo mu mpataa, te sɛ mmoa a wɔwea a obi nni wɔn soɔ.
1.15: Saa nti wɔde darewa atwe wɔn nyinaa, wɔde asau twe wɔn, na wɔboa wɔn ano, ne twiɛ mu; yei nti wɔn ani gye na wɔn ho sɛpɛ wɔn.
1.16: Ne saa nti, abɔnefoɔ bɔ n’asau no afɔdeɛ  na ɔhye aduhwam ma wɔn twiɛ no,  ɛfiri sɛ ɛno na ɛma ne kyɛfa dɔre sradeɛ, na n’aduane yɛ sɔɔsɔɔ.
1.17: Ɛno nti ɔnkɔ so ara mpore n’asau mu,  na ɔnkunkum amanaman daa nyinaa atirimuɔden so?

2.1: Mɛgyina m’ahwɛeɛ, na mede me ho bɛsi aban so, na masra mahwɛ asɛm ko a ɔbɛka akyerɛ me ne deɛ mede bɛbua no wɔ me nkurobɔ no ho.
2.2: Na AWURADE buaa me sɛ: Twerɛ adehunu no, na kyerɛkyerɛ mu gu aboɔpono so, na wɔatumi akan no wɔ ahoɔherɛ so.
2.3: Na adehunu no da so kyerɛ berɛ a wɔahyɛ,  na ɛrepɛ kwan aba mu, na ɛyɛ nokorɛ nso. Sɛ ɛtwentwɛn ase mpo a, twɛn no ara, na ba deɛ, ɛbɛba, ɛrenka akyi.
2.4: Hwɛ, ɔbɔnefoɔ kra huhuru, ɛntene wɔ ne mu, na ɔteneneeni deɛ, ɔnam ne nokorɛdie so na ɔbɛtena ase. Nkonimdifoɔ no nnue!
2.5: Na bio nso, Kaldeafoɔ te sɛ nsabofoɔ.  Na wɔyɛ nnipa ahokyerɛfoɔ a wɔn bo nnwo da; wɔatrɛ wɔn kra akɔnnɔ mu sɛ Asamando, na wɔte sɛ owuo a ɔmmeeɛ,  wɔfa amanaman nnommum ba wɔn nkyɛn na wɔfom aman nyinaa fa.
2.6: Ɛberɛ bi reba a wɔn nnomumfoɔ bɛsere na wɔadi wɔn ho fɛw sɛ:  Ɔnnue, deɛ ɔnam asisie kwan so fa adeɛ a ɛnyɛ ne dea no. W’apoobɔ yi bɛkɔ so ara akɔsi da bɛn?
2.7: Ɛnyɛ mpofirim na wɔn a wɔde wo ka bɛsɔreɛ atia wo,  na wɔbɛnyane na wɔabɛhwanyan woɔ, na woadane wɔn asadeɛ?
2.8: Ɛsiane sɛ woafom amanaman pii afa nti, na woaka nnipa mogya agu, ne nhyɛsoɔ a wode ahyɛ asase, nkuro ne emufoɔ nyinaa soɔ nti aman mu nkaeɛ nyinaa bɛfom wo nso afa.
2.9: Ɔnnue, deɛ ɔnya mfasoɔ bɔne ma ne fie,  sɛ ɔde ne pirebuo bɛsi sorɔnsorɔmmea na wayi ne ho afiri mmusuo nsam no.
2.10: Woatu agyina anya aniwuo ama wo fie, sɛ woatwitwa aman pii aguo, na woayɛ wo kra bɔne.
2.11: Ɔboɔ firi ɔfasuo mu bɛteam, na mpuna afiri nnua mu agye so.
2.12: Ɔnnue, deɛ ɔkyekyere kuro mogya mu, na ɔto aban abusudeɛ mu.
2.13: Hwɛ, ɛmfiri asafo AWURADE nkyɛn  sɛ aman yɛ adwuma brɛ ma ogya,  na nkurɔfoɔ brɛ ma ade hunu?
2.14: Na afei deɛ, AWURADE animuonyam ho nimdeɛ  bɛhyɛ asase so ma sɛdeɛ nsuo kata ɛpo soɔ.
2.15: Due, wo a woma wo yɔnko nsa nom wɔ adwenbɔne kwan soɔ, na woma no borɔ na woahwɛ n’adagya mu.
2.16: Ahohora amee wo asene animuonyam;  wo nso nom, na wo momonoto nna adi; AWURADE nifa mu kuruwa  bɛdane aba wo so,  na ɛfeɛ ne ahohora bɛgu w’animuonyam so.
2.17: Na wo Babel, asɛmmɔne a wɔde dii Lebanon ne mmoa sɛeɛ a ɛbɔɔ wɔn binim no, nnipa mogya a woaka aguo, ne nhyɛsoɔ a wode ahyɛ asase,  kuro ne emufoɔ nyinaa so no nyinaa bɛbua w’atifi.
2.18: Sɛ odwumfoɔ sene ohoni a,  ɛho mfasoɔ ne deɛn?  Ɛyɛ guo honi, kyerɛkyerɛni torofoɔ; ɛfiri sɛ odwumfoɔ yɛ ahoni mum a,  ɔde ne ho to ɔno ara n’adwinnie a ɔdie no so.
2.19: Due, wo a woka kyerɛ dua sɛ: Nyane! Na woka kyerɛ ɔboɔ mum sɛ: Sɔre! Ɛno na ɛbɛkyerɛ adeɛ anaa? Hwɛ, wɔde sika ne dwetɛ adura ho, na ahome biara nni mu.
2.20: Na AWURADE deɛ, ɔwɔ n’asɔrefie kronkron mu;  na momma asase nyinaa nyɛ komm wɔ n’anim.

3.1: Odiyifoɔ Habakuk mpaebɔ wɔ Shigionot so.
3.2: AWURADE, mate wo nka, masuro; O AWURADE, kanyan w’adwuma no wɔ yɛn berɛ yi mu; ɛberɛ yi mu na ma wɔnhunu; w’abufuhyeɛ mu kae mmɔborɔhunu.
3.3: Onyankopɔn firi Teman ba,  na ɔkronkronni no firi Paran bepɔ so. Sela N’animuonyam kata ɔsoro, na n’ayeyie yɛ asase so ma.
3.4: Ne hyerɛn te sɛ owia hann, nsesaeɛ wowɔ ne ho, na ɛhɔ ne n’ahoɔden ahuntaeɛ.
3.5: Ɔyaredɔm a ɛpra di n’anim, na yadeɛ a ɛhyehyeɛ firi di ne nan ase.
3.6: Ɔgyina hɔ na ɔwoso asase,  ɔhwɛ, na ɔma amanaman ho popo;  daa mmepɔ dwiri, tete nkokoɔ brɛ ase, n’akwan te sɛ tete deɛ no.
3.7: Mehunuu Kusan ntomadan wɔ ahohiahia mu; Midian asase so kuntudan no popoe.
3.8: Nsubɔntene so na na w’abufuo redɛreɛ, AWURADE?  Ɛpo na wo bo huru tiaa no, berɛ a na wote w’apɔnkɔ so, wo nkwagyeɛ nteaseɛnam so reba no?
3.9: Woayɛ wo tadua krado; na woaka ntam wɔ w’agyan no toɔ ho.Sela Wopaapae asase mu yɛ no nsubɔntene.
3.10: Mmepɔ hu wo a wɔhinhim;  nsuo a ɛtue reba;  ebunu donkodonko ma ne nne so, ɛma ne nsa so kɔ soro;
3.11: owia ne ɔsrane gyinagyinaa efie, w’agyan a ɛnenam no hann nti, wo pea anyinam pa hyerɛn no nti.
3.12: Abohuro mu na wonam fa asase soɔ, abufuo mu na woposa amanaman.
3.13: Wofirii adi sɛ worebɛgye wo man,  worebɛgye deɛ wɔasra no no;  wobobɔɔ ɔbɔnefoɔ ti, womaa ne ho daa hɔ firi n’atifi de kɔsii ne nan ase.Sela
3.14: Wode mpɛmɛ hwire n’akofoɔ tirim,  wɔtu sɛ ahum ba sɛ wɔrebɛbɔ me apete,  wɔn anigyeɛ ne sɛ wɔbɛmene mmɔborɔni ahuntaeɛ mu.
3.15: Wode wo apɔnkɔ si po mu, nsuo pii a ɛhuro no mu.
3.16: Metee na me yafunum popoe,  m’ano saa biribiri, ɛnne no ho;  ɔporɔ hyɛnee me nnompe mu, na m’ase popoe, nanso meretena ase komm atwɛn ahohiahia da no  na mahwɛ deɛ ɔbɛyɛ ɔman a wɔbɛtoaa yɛn no. AWURADE mu anidasoɔ
3.17: Na borɔdɔma rengu nhyerɛne,  na aba biara nni abobe so;  na ngodua soɔ di hwammɔ, na mfuo mma aduane, na nnwan to twa firi ban mu,  na nantwie biara nni adan mu mpo a,
3.18: me deɛ AWURADE mu na mɛdi ahurisie,  na me ho bɛsɛpɛ me wɔ nkwagyeɛ Nyankopɔn mu.
3.19: ONYANKOPƆN, Awurade no, ne m’ahoɔden; na ɔma me nan yɛ sɛ aforoteɛ deɛ, na ɔma menante me sorɔnsorɔmmea.  Wɔmfa mma dwonkyerɛni na wɔnto no m’asankuo so.
